limits: No live extraction or Obsidian import tested in this review.
Contact sheets sample frames; they do not perform OCR, semantic visual analysis or continuous motion review.
Keep original-language text and machine-transcription provenance; verify quotes against source audio before using them in lessons.
Integration requires an adapter for the project's existing faster-whisper; no new model or automatic download activated.
